blocks.x: Fleet Management System's architecture: the planes, the controls and the evidence export — documented the way your auditors will read it.
Structurally Fleet Management System is planes, not layers — workload, decision and evidence run in parallel behind one governed API, and each crossing is logged with policy version and owner.
the build decomposes into named pieces, each with an owner and a gate, Fleet Management System architecture edition:

items: feature store, vector search, retrieval services
owned, SLA'd products with consumer contracts

items: sharing without exposure for data products

blocks.x: Runtime dependencies: Databricks, Snowflake, Kafka, dbt, Unity Catalog/Purview. Deployment runs inside your security perimeter with customer-managed keys; the evidence export is formatted for the audit formats your team already uses.

Deployment models for Fleet Management System follow the estate: in-perimeter on customer-managed keys, or in a segregated enclave where the estate cannot host the workload. Either way the control pack, the replay log and the audit export keep the same format, so the second deployment never re-argues the first.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: Fleet Management System architecture baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
